basics.name: Bruno Galiz de Oliveira
basics.label: Mid-level Full Stack Developer
basics.summary: Full stack developer since 2019. Today I maintain the State of Tocantins fleet system with Vue.js, Java and Spring Boot. Before that, I migrated Conexa Saúde's medical record from JSP to React and shipped Mato Grosso do Sul's Covid Vaccination Card to both app stores.

work.name: AZ Tecnologia em Gestão
work.summary: Vehicle Control System for the State of Tocantins.
highlights: PDF and Excel reports that follow the columns and the filter chosen on screen.
Made the fleet table columns dynamic: users pick which ones show, and the report comes out with exactly those.
Build and maintain REST APIs in Java 11 and Spring Boot, with JPAQuery queries over PostgreSQL and OracleDB.
Reworked menu items and the responsive layout of the Vue.js and TypeScript front end.

work.name: Easy Imóveis
highlights: Performance optimization of the property search page.
Built custom filters, interactive maps and form flows with reusable components in Nuxt and Vue.js.

work.name: Conexa Saúde
highlights: Modularization of the electronic medical record and migration from JSP to React.
Migrated medical record modules from legacy JSP to React with Hooks and TypeScript, without taking down what was already live.
Turned the forms into configurable modules: each clinic creates the fields it needs, with no deploy.
Maintained the business-rule modules in Vue.js, on a Scrum team.

work.name: Calango Doido NFT
highlights: Connected the React front end to Web3 digital wallets (MetaMask) to read each user's NFTs.
Built a browser memory game from the tokens in the connected wallet.
Shipped the collection landing page in Next.js, on Vercel.

work.name: SGI, Governo de Mato Grosso do Sul
work.summary: Information Management Office (SGI), State of Mato Grosso do Sul.
highlights: Digital Vaccination Card during the Covid pandemic, shipped to the App Store and Google Play.
Also worked on the SUS Card and the Free Pass apps, in Ionic with Angular.
Prepared the builds in Android Studio and Xcode and handled the store releases.
Worked on the MS Digital portal and on REST APIs in Node.js with Sequelize and SQL Server.
keywords: Publishing to the App Store and Google Play

work.name: Reduza
highlights: Price crawlers in Node.js and one web page per store, optimized for SEO.
Wrote scraping bots with automatic refresh cycles, with data in MongoDB and Redis.
Built real-time price comparison across stores, with an Angular front end.

projects.name: AssetForge
projects.description: Game asset generator ready for Unity: from a text description (or an image) to a Humanoid FBX with textures, prefab and animations.
highlights: Clean Architecture in Python, with an AI provider router that switches services when a free quota runs out.
Headless Blender and MakeHuman generate fully rigged characters, plus a library of 45 free animations.
A Unity package imports everything on its own: Humanoid Avatar, URP materials, prefab and a locomotion Animator. 73 tests.

projects.name: Copiloto de Trading
projects.description: Decision-support system for trading on MetaTrader 5, in observation mode: it reads the chart, sizes the risk and explains, but never places an order.
highlights: Never shows a confidence percentage: it shows "3 of 4 criteria aligned", checkable item by item on the chart.
Logs every trade in a journal, to measure whether there is a real edge.
Has 743 automated tests; the autonomous executor runs on a demo account only, reviewed weekly.

projects.name: E-PLAY
projects.description: App for the E-PLAY community: schedule matches, score on a leaderboard, read the Bible as a group and follow the live streams.
highlights: React with Capacitor builds the Android APK from the same web code, with builds on GitHub Actions.
Supabase on the back end: Google sign-in, LGPD consent and a public profile with privacy controls.
Rule-based automatic moderation (block, warn, ban), an offline Bible with search, and a color-blind mode with 4 options.

projects.name: Cronômetro de Oradores
projects.description: Speaking-time control for speakers at meetings and events, with visual and audio alerts, a speaker log and PDF export.
highlights: Timer and bell logic in dedicated hooks, kept apart from the UI.
On-screen QR code and PDF export of the speaker log.

projects.name: Mini n8n
projects.description: Visual automation-flow editor, in the style of n8n, that sends messages through a Telegram bot.
highlights: React front end with React Flow: the flow is built by dragging nodes.
REST API in Node.js and Express that talks to the Telegram API, with a configurable delay between sends to avoid being blocked.

skills.name: Mobile and games
keywords: Publishing to the App Store and Google Play
